crossRefs.note: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’”
The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”
When they came to Reuel, their father, he said, “How is it that you have returned so early today?”

translations.web: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”
translations.bsb: “Where is He?” they asked. “I do not know,” he answered.
translations.kjv: Then said they unto him, Where is he? He said, I know not.
translations.asv: And they said unto him, Where is he? He saith, I know not.
